content.title: 'He's Fine': Netanyahu's Office Dismisses Claims Of His Death, Calls Assassination Rumours 'Fake'

Responding to a query from an Anadolu Agency correspondent about the viral claims, Netanyahu's office said the reports were false.Trending Stories >>RG Rape Case: Victim’s Mother Joins BJP, Sparks Political Debate Ahead Of PollsUndoBoman Irani Takes A Witty Swipe At Donald Trump Amid Iran Talks Buzz, Says ‘Bring Gas Cylinder’Undo‘Hugged Him, Then Killed Him’: 15-Year-Old Stabbed To Death By Three Minors In Delhi’s DayalpurUndo When asked whether there was any statement regarding the rumours that Netanyahu had been killed, the office rejected the claims outright. “These are fake news; the Prime Minister is fine,” the office said in response.
